field.label: Name
field.help: Friendly name for this subscription (e.g. provider name).

field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: The http(s) link that returns the proxy list (vless://… etc., optionally Base64-encoded).

field.label: Auto update
field.help: Periodically re-fetch this subscription and sync its servers on the schedule below.

field.label: Update interval (hours)
field.help: How often to refresh when auto-update is enabled (1–168 hours). Default is 4.

field.label: Body decoding
field.help: How the subscription body is decoded. "Auto-detect" handles both plain and Base64-encoded lists (recommended).

field.label: Exclude keywords
field.help: Comma-separated words. Servers whose name contains any of these (case-insensitive) are skipped and removed on sync — e.g. "LTE, TORRENT". Leave empty to keep all.
